description: Engine families and per-release support status. A status applies only to the exact listed release (game code + approved clean hash). Any other release of a title is at most 'recognized'. Statuses are evidence-backed claims and must never be raised without that evidence.

gb.name: Game Boy / Game Boy Color engine
gb.shared: cartridge header/global checksum validation and refresh
gb.next: bank-addressed data tables (species, moves, encounters, trainers) and save layout per revision; expansion requires a new species/save architecture beyond 8-bit IDs

gba.name: Game Boy Advance Generation III engine
gba.shared: cartridge header validation and complement-checksum refresh; BIOS LZ77 codec
gba.next: pointer-located data tables per revision; free-space allocation for expansion

nds-gen4.name: Nintendo DS Generation IV engine
nds-gen4.shared: NDS header/FNT/FAT/overlays/ARM9 and strict NARC (shared with Generation V)
nds-gen4.next: Generation IV archive identities and encounter/trainer/personal codecs per game

nds-gen5.name: Nintendo DS Generation V engine
nds-gen5.shared: NDS container, NARC, Generation V encounter/trainer codecs, script disassembler, W2U-backed expansion
nds-gen5.next: Black/White and Black 2 build paths (W2U provides a White 2 ROM build only)

ctr-gen6.name: Nintendo 3DS Generation VI engine
ctr-gen6.shared: NCSD/NCCH header and crypto-state inspection; strict GARC archive codec
ctr-gen6.next: decrypted RomFS/ExeFS extraction and rebuild, then per-game GARC identities

ctr-gen7.name: Nintendo 3DS Generation VII engine
ctr-gen7.shared: NCSD/NCCH header and crypto-state inspection; strict GARC archive codec
ctr-gen7.next: decrypted RomFS/ExeFS extraction and rebuild, then per-game GARC identities

pinned_releases.evidence: approved clean SHA-256; W2U-backed rebuild, structural and semantic verification (synthetic and mock end-to-end tests)
pinned_releases.missing_for_next_status: feature-complete needs #1024/#1025, hidden items, shops and save-format expansion; runtime-validated needs the first-play checklist

pinned_releases.evidence: approved clean SHA-256 (used as a W2U build input)
